items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: I said, 'How would you like to come with the band.' ... And we started out and everything was fine.

ctx.x: Lou Fromm, drums. Killian, McGhee, Holland and Pettiford do not appear on camera, as white actors sat in their places. Okay, tell me the bass story.
Well, that -- well, first of all, about, "Jam Session," that was recorded all over the -- filmed all over the country, and then they sewed it together in Hollywood,

so I can imagine how disjointed -- I never saw it, but I can imagine how -- what a cross patched, messed up thing it must be. Some of it was done in New York, some was done in Hollywood, and then, you know, they just recorded and filmed segments and sewed it together afterwards. They wrote the story afterwards, I think, and fit in all these things. If there was a story. Oh, you asked about Pettiford.
